title: Empowering States' Right To Protect Consumers Act of 2009
short_title: Empowering States' Right To Protect Consumers Act of 2009

summaries.text: Empowering States' Right To Protect Consumers Act of 2009 - Amends the Truth In Lending Act to limit the annual percentage rate (APR) applicable to any consumer credit transaction (other than a residential mortgage transaction), including any associated fees, to the maximum rate permitted by the laws of the state in which the consumer resides.
